resources.string: Log in to your company account.
Create your account with a company invitation.
Keep your contact details up to date.
Ask your company for an invitation linked to your email. New accounts are registered as workers.
Use 12–64 characters and at most 64 UTF-8 bytes. Name: up to 120 characters.
Phone: 7–32 characters, digits, optional leading +, spaces, () . or -. Leaving it blank keeps the current number.
Logout clears this device and requests server revocation. If the connection fails, revocation cannot be confirmed.
Signed out on this device. Server revocation was not confirmed; that session may remain active until expiry or administrative revocation.
Account created. Log in with your credentials.
Check the email, name, invitation and password or phone limits.
Your session is no longer valid. Log in again.
Your account does not have permission for this action.
The invitation is invalid, expired, already used or linked to another email.
Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
Unable to connect. Check your connection and retry.
The session could not be saved securely. Try again.
